description.text:
In this role responsibilities include, but not limited to:
1. Responsible for bringing up the board, porting Linux device drivers. (e.g. Sensors, Display, Touch, Audio, BT, WiFi, LTE, Camera…)
2. Responsible for tuning stability and performance.
3. Implement autotest scripts.
4. Work with component vendors to solve issues.
5. Produce specifications and determine functional feasibility.
6. Maintain software functionality.
